title: Welcome to the blog
summary: What this space is for, and what to expect here.
body:
This is a starter post. Replace it with your own writing.

## What goes here

- Short write-ups of data projects: the question, the method, the result.
- Notes on SQL, Python and Power BI that I wish I had found sooner.
- Experiments with AI tools and what actually worked.

## How posts are written

Posts use simple **Markdown**: headings, lists, `inline code`, links like [GitHub](https://github.com/Shubhamkeshri433), and code blocks.

```sql
SELECT department, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary
FROM employees
GROUP BY department;
```

> Without data, you're just another person with an opinion.
